name: Performs bulk actions on an array of task_schedulers
description: Performs bulk actions on an array of task_schedulers
whenToUse: Perform a bulk action (archive/restore/delete) over an array of task scheduler ids in one request (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```
